title: The Savannah Club with Lucille Dixon and the Celebrity Club offer
summary: Tate plays Lucille Dixon's show band downtown, and the Celebrity Club owner asks him to form a band.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: It was like a -- it was like the Cotton Club. So she asked me if I'd come down and work with her. So Eddie Condon's was just across the street then. That street

was jumping, you know? I thought I would, so I left Rush to go down there and work with her. And then I had played one gig for the fella that owned the Celebrity Club in Freeport and he owned the one here. He had two clubs, one in Freeport and one -- so he used to tell me all the time, he says, "You know, I sure would like for you to form your own band and work in one of my clubs." So I said, "Well, I can't work in the one in Freeport," because I was living in New York then. So he says, "Well, this band I got in here has been in here for seven years." I says, "Seven years?" So he says, "Yeah, they have been here for seven years, but I'm going to let them go."
